connector.name: Psychosynth
connector.registryDescription: Psychometric data marketplace: Big Five profiles, cognitive biases & behavioral data via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package psychosynth-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 3esign account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: PSYCHOSYNTH_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Psychosynth API deployment (e.g. https://your-app.vercel.app). Defaults to http://localhost:3000 for local development.

env.name: BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Base (EVM) wallet private key used to pay for queries via x402. Omit to use only the free catalog, preview, and quote tools.

env.name: BASE_RPC_URL
env.description: Optional custom Base mainnet RPC endpoint. Defaults to https://mainnet.base.org.
